roleContext.roleTitle: Reliability Statistician, Industrial Pump Fleet Analytics
roleContext.jobDescription: The pump fleet analytics team estimates failure rates and maintenance intervals for the industrial pumps the company services under contract. The Reliability Statistician builds the survival and degradation models behind the maintenance intervals, reviews the field failure data with the service engineers, and defends the interval recommendations to the contract customers. The team requires a master's degree in statistics or a related quantitative field, because the interval methodology is filed with customers as the work of a qualified statistician, together with three years of applied reliability modelling. Reports to the head of fleet analytics; works with the service engineers, the data platform team and the contract managers.

requirements.text: Holds a master's degree in statistics or a related quantitative field.
Has at least three years of applied reliability modelling on field failure data.
Builds survival and degradation models behind the maintenance interval recommendations.
Reviews field failure data with the service engineers under a documented data quality procedure.
Documents model limitations and interval boundaries for the contract customers.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Reliability Statistician, Industrial Pump Fleet Analytics

## Experience

- Reliability analyst on the pump fleet analytics team of a pump service company for three years and seven months, building the survival and degradation models behind the maintenance intervals for two pump families.
- Education: BEng, Mechanical Engineering, 2018; postgraduate modules in applied statistics at a distance-learning university, two of eight modules completed in 2023 and 2024, no award.
- Reviewed the field failure data with the service engineers each month under the team's data quality procedure, keeping the exclusion log for mislabelled failures.
- Wrote the model limitation notes and the interval boundary statements sent to contract customers with each interval recommendation, and presented the recommendations to two contract customers with the head of fleet analytics.
- Before the pump service company, eighteen months as a maintenance planning analyst at a paper mill, using the mill's failure records to plan overhauls.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the survival model workbook and the interval recommendation note for one pump family, with the data platform query references as a verification trail, and the transcript of the two completed postgraduate modules.
